description: Layout of the PC controls (rebinding) screen, opened from OPTION > Controller Config and from the options menu's Key Bindings row. Positions are in the 320x240 text space (the options draw only y 0..224): device tabs, rules, the action list with a primary and a secondary column, hit boxes, menu font colours (gold, dark_grey, green, red, light_grey, white), icon tints (0..255, 128 = unlit), text keys of gamedata/text and literal cell texts. The keys starting with '_' explain the key of the same name. Keys left out keep the built-in values; an unknown key is an error.
_tab_x: Centres of the Keyboard, Mouse and Gamepad tab labels.
_head_y: Primary / Secondary headings on the Keyboard and Mouse tabs, the Gamepad Icons row on the Gamepad tab.
_label_w: Room for an action label after its bullet: wider labels are cut with ... and pan while selected.
_icon_layer: Drawn after the text layer (8), so an icon quad's texture page cannot touch a font glyph.
_columns: [x, w] of the primary and the secondary bind of the tab's device. A pad bind is its icon and its label; a name wider than the cell is cut with ... and pans while selected.

texts._action_prefix: A row's label is drawn from this prefix and the label as a slug (Back / Cancel -> ui.bind.back_cancel).
